Ivy (Docs): quick sync — i'm polishing the release note and migration snippet for the embed routing change. want one short "what changed" bullet, a 1-line migration tip, and matching SDK samples.
Noah (Product): keep customer language very short. note: default is latency-first; deterministic opt-in exists; small ordering quirk on first requests.
Zoe (SDK): i'll add Python + TS snippets. confirmed field is `route_hint` and values `latency` / `deterministic`. will keep code blocks single-column.
Hank (Eng): runtime note: model alias renamed to `embed-alpha-lowlatency`. 301s in place but call out new name. also KB stub: https://kb.redwood.ai/embed-routing-ordering (placeholder).
Ivy (Docs): draft migration line: "If exact token order matters, set `route_hint: \"deterministic\"` while cache warmup completes (may slightly increase latency)."
Noah (Product): good. add a one-line known issue: "Initial requests after cache cold start can show minor token-order differences; see KB."
Zoe (SDK): samples will include streaming flag and a commented guard: `# use deterministic for stable ordering`. also update SDK README.
preview-bot: preview ready for PR 5488: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-5488 :white_check_mark:
Ivy (Docs): final checklist: 1) SDK snippets (Zoe) 2) KB page (Hank) 3) preview + mobile check (Noah) 4) add known-issues anchor (Ivy). aiming to merge Friday AM.
Noah (Product): i'll notify support and marketing once merged. thanks everyone. :tada:
